content.title: [Brand] 4.5L Air Fryer, 1400W Digital, 8 Presets, PTFE Nonstick Basket
bullets: 4.5L CAPACITY FOR EVERYDAY MEALS – The 4.5-liter (about 4.8-quart) basket holds fries, wings, veggies, or reheated leftovers, and the compact body fits on most countertops.
8 ONE-TOUCH PRESETS – Eight built-in cooking programs mean no guessing on time and temperature for everyday favorites. Pick a preset, press start, and get on with your day.
EASY DIGITAL TOUCH CONTROLS – The digital touch panel lets you set and adjust cooking with a tap. The 60-minute timer handles everything from quick snacks to longer roasts.

CRISPY RESULTS WITH LESS OIL – Hot circulating air gives food a golden, crispy finish while using less oil than traditional deep frying. You get the crunch you want without a pot of hot oil on the stove.

DISHWASHER-SAFE NONSTICK BASKET – The PTFE nonstick-coated basket releases food easily and goes straight into the dishwasher, so cleanup takes less time. Built for standard US outlets (120V, 60Hz, 1400W).
content.description:
Get crispy, golden results without deep frying. The [Brand] 4.5L Digital Air Fryer circulates hot air around your food, so you can make fries, chicken wings, roasted vegetables, and more with less oil than a traditional fryer. The 1400-watt heating system runs on a standard 120V US outlet.

Cooking is simple. Choose one of 8 presets on the digital touch panel, or set your own time with the 60-minute timer. The 4.5-liter (about 4.8-quart) basket gives you room for snacks, sides, and weeknight dinners.

Cleanup is just as easy. The basket has a PTFE nonstick coating, so food releases without much scrubbing, and it is dishwasher safe.

findings.problem_zh: 供应商资料没有说明本产品是否需要加州 65 号提案警示。产品含 PTFE 不粘涂层，PFOA 只有供应商声明，没有第三方报告。目前商品页文案里没有任何 65 号提案警示，也没有标明 WARNING 的链接，是否合规无法确认，需要人工核实。
findings.suggestion_zh: 请向工厂索取涂层及其他接触材料（含电源线、塑料件）的第三方检测报告，确认是否含有加州 65 号提案清单中的物质。如需警示，应在商品页加入完整警示文字，或加入标明 "WARNING" 的超链接，写明具体化学物质名称、危害类型和 www.P65Warnings.ca.gov。不要在资料未确认的情况下自行写入化学物质名称。

content.hook: ¿Sigues friendo con un montón de aceite? Mira esto 👀

script.shot_zh: 厨房台面特写，手从包装盒里拿出空气炸锅放到台面上
script.line: Les presento mi nueva freidora de aire de 4.5 litros, ¡y está bien bonita!

script.shot_zh: 手指点触数显面板，屏幕亮起，依次切换预设菜单
script.line: Tiene panel touch digital y 8 programas ya listos: nomás le picas y ya.

script.shot_zh: 往篮子里放薯条，用刷子刷一点点油，推入锅中，设定时间
script.line: Le pongo poquito aceite a las papas, le programo el tiempo, hasta 60 minutos, y me voy a hacer otra cosa.

script.shot_zh: 拉出篮子，金黄薯条倒进盘子，咬一口发出脆响
script.line: ¡Miren nomás qué doraditas quedaron! Y con mucho menos aceite que en el sartén.

script.shot_zh: 把篮子放进洗碗机，关门，对镜头比赞
script.line: Y lo mejor para mí: la canasta va directo al lavavajillas. Cero batallar lavando.

content.caption: Mi nueva compañera de cocina 🍟 Freidora de aire digital de 4.5 L con 8 programas, panel touch, timer de hasta 60 minutos y canasta que puedes meter al lavavajillas. Cocina con poquito aceite y sin tanto rollo. ¿Qué le meterían primero? 👇
content.notes_zh: 用墨西哥口语（nomás、le picas、cero batallar）展示开箱→触控预设→少油烹饪→洗碗机清洗，只写资料内事实（4.5L、8预设、触控数显、60分钟定时、篮子可进洗碗机、少油）；未提NOM/UL、PFOA无添加及健康功效；注意：资料标注额定电压为120V 60Hz，与要求写的127V不一致，为避免误标电气参数文案中暂未写电压，请确认产品实际额定电压后再补充。
